arria-cs: Veridian (dedicated) ping — they saw P95 latency regressions on short, bursty traffic after the latest runtime canary. Customer is sensitive to tail latency. Asking if we can tweak their request aggregation + queue limits for a short ramp while we investigate.

samir-profiling: quick perf dump from the canary pool: median_batch_size=1.3, p95_batch_size=4, kv_miss_rate=46.8%, kernel_switch_count spikes on small seqs. Looks like coalescing window too small for their traffic shape. Snippet: ```json
{"median_batch":1.3,"p95_batch":4,"kv_miss_pct":46.8,"small_seq_frac":0.62}
```

mira-eng: thanks. Proposed temporary per-tenant override for Veridian pool: increase aggregation window, raise coalescing token target, and bump per-queue token ceiling to avoid head-of-line drops. Minimal config patch (canary 5% -> 25% if green):

```yaml
tenant: veridian-prod-dedicated
overrides:
  aggregation_ms: 8            # from 4 -> 8 to allow more small requests to coalesce
  max_coalesce_tokens: 128    # from 48 -> 128 to form larger batches on short completions
  queue_soft_limit: 0.8       # allow slightly higher queue headroom (0-1)
  per_queue_token_ceiling: 600 # raise per-queue token budget for burst smoothing
  kv_prefetch: true           # enable prefetch for common prompts to reduce miss
  kernel_fallback: allow      # permit fallback to float kernel if quant kernel regresses
```

mira-eng: rationale — aggregation_ms balances latency vs batch size; raising tokens helps requests that generate 50-150 tokens. kv_prefetch should cut KV miss noise we saw.

bryan-runtime: I support the patch but want circuit-breaker thresholds: if p95 > baseline+40ms or cost delta > +8% in 30m, roll back automatically. Also enable extra tracing for kernel selection so we can see if fallback triggers. I'll add the rollout policy: canary 5% for 30m -> 25% for 1h -> 100% if checks pass.

ops-bot: rollout scheduled: veridian-agg-override canary @ 2027-05-07T14:30:00Z (5%) — monitoring hooks attached.

arria-cs: I'll tell the customer we're planning a gentle ramp and will monitor latency/cost carefully. Also asked them for example prompt mix and a few request ids hitting p95 so we can correlate.

samir-profiling: after enabling kv_prefetch in a quick internal sim we saw kv_miss drop ~18% and median batch ~1.9 -> p95 expected to move down. Will run a longer sim overnight and post results.

mira-eng: action items: 1) I'll push the canary override at the scheduled time. 2) samir will post simulated traces + kernel selection logs. 3) bryan will add automatic rollback thresholds and extra tracing. 4) arria to coordinate with Veridian support.

bryan-runtime: one note — if we see increased cost due to larger coalescing (more tokens per batch leading to more wasted tokens), we should consider dynamic token_budget_target that scales with observed completion length. But that's a follow-up.

arria-cs: ack, thanks all. I'll update the Veridian ticket with the schedule and escalate if they want a maintenance window.

samir-profiling: posting preliminary sim results here tomorrow.```
